entries.title: Seollal (설날)
entries.content: Lunar New Year. Families bow to elders (sebae), eat rice-cake soup (tteokguk) and say you are 'one year older' after the bowl.
entries.label: Culture - education

entries.title: Daeboreum (정월대보름)
entries.content: The first full moon of the lunar year. People crack nuts (bureom) for healthy teeth and watch the moon rise.
entries.label: Culture - education

entries.title: Dano (단오)
entries.content: Lunar May 5. Traditional swings, wrestling (ssireum) and washing hair in iris water.
entries.label: Culture - education

entries.title: Chuseok (추석)
entries.content: Harvest festival on lunar August 15. Families make half-moon rice cakes (songpyeon) and honor ancestors.
entries.label: Culture - education

entries.title: Dongji (동지)
entries.content: Winter solstice. Red bean porridge (patjuk) is eaten to keep bad luck away.
entries.label: Culture - education

entries.title: 2027: the Fire Goat year
entries.content: The saju year 2027 is Jeong-mi 丁未, Yin Fire over Goat (Earth). It starts at Ipchun, about Feb 4, 2027.
entries.label: Culture - education
